title: Lattice Escrow
summary: Lock native SOL in a program-owned escrow PDA, then have the Lattice authority release it to the agent (minus a 1/67 protocol fee).
what: Lattice Escrow is a small Anchor 0.32.1 SOL rail: the payer creates a program-owned PDA, and the lattice_wallet authority later releases the amount to the agent (fee = amount / 67) or refunds the payer after timeout. This lesson covers create_escrow and release_escrow.
app_note: The page at /dapps/lattice-escrow/ is the generic IDL-driven wallet console. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/lattice-escrow. The lab only changed declare_id to a unique lab program and pointed the Anchor.toml wallet at the local CLI keypair.

try_steps.do: Open /dapps/lattice-escrow/, switch to Devnet, and connect a wallet. The lab already ran create_escrow and release_escrow for transaction_id campus-scout-1 with 1_000_000 lamports.
try_steps.see: Program BTDakBxR…. Escrow EdmCgtFn… should be Released, with 1_696_720 lamports of rent still in the PDA; the agent received 985_075 and the lattice wallet received a 14_925 fee.

try_steps.do: release_escrow signed by anyone other than lattice_wallet should fail.

diagram: payer --create_escrow--> escrow ["escrow", payer, transaction_id] (program-owned, rent + amount) ; lattice_wallet --release_escrow--> agent (amount - fee) + lattice_wallet (fee = amount/67)
accounts: escrow (seeds ["escrow", payer, transaction_id bytes], owner = this program)
innovation: A tiny program-owned SOL escrow with a fixed 1/67 Lattice fee, released only by the recorded lattice_wallet.
exercises: Fetch escrow EdmCgtFn… and confirm status is Released.
Explain why release can debit this PDA.
Sketch the timeout path for refund_escrow.
not_covered: refund_escrow was not exercised. The escrow PDA is not closed after release (rent remains).
objectives: Derive or locate the escrow PDA used by Lattice.
Fund the escrow and observe locked token balances.
Explain which condition unlocks release vs reclaim.
prereqs: A Devnet wallet with practice funds.
Understanding of PDA seeds from [Picassol](/lessons/picassol-hackathon/) or Foundations.
student_outcome: Create a lattice escrow and verify that only the Lattice authority can release.

learning_loop.objective: Inspect a Released Lattice escrow — then predict who may call release_escrow.
learning_loop.predict_question: release_escrow is signed by a wallet that is not lattice_wallet. What should happen?

predict_options.label: Anyone can release once the escrow exists
Release fails; only lattice_wallet may release
Only the agent payee may release

learning_loop.predict_why: Lattice gates release_escrow to lattice_wallet. A non-authority signer is rejected even if the escrow is funded.
learning_loop.act: Open /dapps/lattice-escrow/ on Devnet. Fetch escrow EdmCgtFn… (Released). Prefer recorded create/fund/release proofs; explain why foreign signers fail release.
learning_loop.explain_question: Why is authority-gated release different from a timeout refund path?
learning_loop.transfer: Name who can release now, and which refund path this lesson did not exercise.

assessment.purpose: Independent elective criteria; no Picassol leakage.

criteria.title: Locates escrow PDA
criteria.question: Can the student identify the Lattice escrow account?

criteria.title: Explains authority gate
criteria.question: Can the student predict non-lattice_wallet release failure?
criteria.misconception: Funded escrow means anyone may release.

criteria.title: Scopes refund_escrow out
criteria.question: Does the student note timeout/refund was not exercised?
